=========================================
valid item followed by invalid tokens
=========================================

( a ) a ( ( ) )

---

(source_file
  (item
    (name))
  (ERROR
    (name)))

=========================================
valid item followed by invalid tokens, then an extra
=========================================

( a ) a ( ( ) ) # comment

---

(source_file
  (item
    (name))
  (ERROR
    (name))
  (comment))
